title: megahal
blurb: talk to a MegaHAL-style learning chatterbot, entirely in your browser — eight brains to pick from (default, aliens, ferris, pepys, pulp, sherlock, startrek, starwars), and it learns from what you type as you go. asked for by shimmermathlabs.com, inspired by github.com/kranzky/megahal.
